categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在Agent能力评测与训练、世界模型、推理加速和具身导航等方向，同时补上了音频、芯片设计等领域的开源数据缺口。

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-Jev: A Unified Interface for Audio Decisions
articles.zh: Qwen-Audio-Jev：面向音频决策的统一接口
articles.summary: 如果你在做音频理解相关的Agent，这篇把分类、判断、决策统一到一个接口里，省得每个任务单训一个模型
articles.author: Ying Fang, Zhifu Gao 等
articles.body: Large audio language models (LALMs) have made substantial progress in audio understanding. However, in high-throughput applications requiring frequent selection, judgment, and scoring, autoregressive text generation introduces additional computational overhead and response latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Qwen-Audio-Jev by augmenting Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next with a dedicated Jev decision head. The model unifies selection, binary judgment, and scoring through three decision primitives: CHOICE, NOUL, and SCORE. Given audio, a natural-language question, and an explicit answer specification, it directly produces a task-conditioned probability distribution or a numerical score through typed decision readouts. Evaluation across 18 labeled configurations covers all three primitives: for CHOICE, Qwen-Audio-Jev achieves accuracies of 78.70% on MMAU-mini and 84.06% on MMSU; for NOUL, it achieves an equal error rate of 6.50% on the VoxCeleb1-O speaker verification benchmark; and for SCORE, the model achieves a normalized mean absolute error of 0.1062 on NISQA overall quality assessment, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.8210 and 0.8074, respectively. Compared with the original Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next, Qwen-Audio-Jev achieves an approximately 20x inference speedup. It demonstrates its potential for efficient, high-throughput audio decision-making in applications such as large-scale audio screening, speaker verification, and automated quality assessment.
articles.bodyZh:
大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在音频理解方面已经取得了不小的进步。但是，在一些需要频繁做选择、判断和打分的高吞吐量场景里，自回归文本生成会带来额外的计算开销和响应延迟。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 Qwen-Audio-Jev——在 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next 的基础上加了一个专门的 Jev 决策头。这个模型通过三种决策原语把选择、二值判断和打分统一了起来，分别是 CHOICE、NOUL 和 SCORE。给它一段音频、一个用自然语言提的问题，再加上明确的答案规范，它就能直接给出一个跟任务相关的概率分布，或者通过类型化的决策读数输出一个数值分数。

我们在 18 种标注配置上做了评估，覆盖了全部三种原语：在 CHOICE 方面，Qwen-Audio-Jev 在 MMAU-mini 上达到了 78.70% 的准确率，在 MMSU 上是 84.06%；在 NOUL 方面，它在 VoxCeleb1-O 说话人验证基准上做到了 6.50% 的等错误率；在 SCORE 方面，这个模型在 NISQA 整体质量评估上取得了 0.1062 的归一化平均绝对误差，皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼相关系数分别是 0.8210 和 0.8074。

跟原来的 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next 相比，Qwen-Audio-Jev 的推理速度大约快了 20 倍。这说明它在大规模音频筛选、说话人验证和自动化质量评估这类应用里，有潜力实现高效、高吞吐量的音频决策。

articles.title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
articles.zh: 在潜空间世界模型中学习内在动力学
articles.summary: 如果你在搞世界模型，这篇提醒你别只顾预测下一帧，真正难的是把系统自身的内在动力学从观测里剥出来
articles.author: Jiamin Shi, Yuanhong Zhang 等
articles.body: Learning intrinsic dynamics---the relationship between actions and their consequences---is essential for world models. However, visual variations unrelated to the underlying control process can obscure this relationship in learned representations. We investigate the connection between action predictability, defined as the ability to reconstruct an action from consecutive latent states, and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics. Our central hypothesis is that encouraging action predictability discourages representations from discarding the distinctions between different actions and their consequences. We provide two complementary forms of evidence for this connection. Theoretically, we derive a positive lower bound on squared inverse prediction error when the encoder merges distinguishable outcomes of different actions from the same state and appearance, and show that forward prediction can still be exact on those transitions. Empirically, controlled appearance-diversity comparisons, supervision interventions, and latent probes support the role of action prediction in preserving control-relevant transition information. We instantiate action predictability with Concat IDM, which predicts actions from concatenated latent states and updates the shared encoder using action labels already available in offline trajectories, without changing the test-time planner. Across three independent training runs on Push-T with 24 appearances, Concat IDM increases planning success from 9.1% to 77.2%; its paired improvement is 52.9 percentage points larger than that observed with a single appearance. Together, these findings support action predictability as an inductive bias toward intrinsic dynamics and demonstrate the practical benefits of Concat IDM for latent planning under visual diversity.
articles.bodyZh: 搞懂内在动力学（intrinsic dynamics）——也就是动作和它带来的后果之间的关系——对世界模型（world models）来说特别关键。但问题是，那些跟底层控制过程无关的视觉变化，会把学到的表征（representations）里这层关系给搅乱。我们研究的是动作可预测性（action predictability）——也就是从连续的潜在状态（latent states）里反推出动作的能力——跟内在动力学能不能被保住之间有什么关系。我们的核心假设是：鼓励动作可预测性，能让表征不把不同动作以及它们后果之间的区别丢掉。我们为这个联系提供了两种互补的证据。理论上，如果编码器（encoder）把同一个状态、同一个外观下，不同动作本来能区分开的结果给合并到一起，我们能推出平方逆预测误差（squared inverse prediction error）有一个正的下界；而且还能证明，前向预测（forward prediction）在这些转换上依然可以做到完全准确。实验上，我们做了受控的外观多样性（appearance-diversity）对比、监督干预（supervision interventions），还有潜在探针（latent probes），结果都支持动作预测在保留控制相关转移信息（control-relevant transition information）这件事上确实有作用。我们具体用 Concat IDM 来实现动作可预测性：它从拼接起来的潜在状态里预测动作，并用离线轨迹（offline trajectories）里本来就有的动作标签来更新共享编码器（shared encoder），而且测试时的规划器（test-time planner）完全不用改。在 Push-T 环境、24 种外观下跑了三次独立训练，Concat IDM 把规划成功率（planning success）从 9.1% 提到了 77.2%；跟只用一种外观时相比，它这种配对提升高出了 52.9 个百分点。合在一起看，这些发现说明：动作可预测性是一种朝内在动力学靠拢的归纳偏置（inductive bias），也证明了 Concat IDM 在视觉变化多的情况下做潜在规划（latent planning）确实有实用价值。

articles.title: Evaluating Inquiry Learning in LLM-Based Agents: Hypothesizing, Reasoning, and Exploration
articles.zh: 评估基于LLM的Agent的探究式学习：假设、推理与探索
articles.summary: 如果你想知道Agent到底会不会"做研究"，这篇给了一套拆成假设-推理-探索三段的评测方法，结论大概率没你想的乐观
articles.author: Marta Knežević, Seyed Parsa Neshaei 等
articles.body: Scientific inquiry involves iterative cycles of exploration, hypothesis generation, and reasoning over observations to uncover relationships in complex systems. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in several components of this process, including inductive reasoning, hypothesis generation, and data analysis. However, prior work typically evaluates these abilities in isolation, leaving open how models integrate them across a full inquiry cycle. In this work, we introduce a framework for evaluating LLMs' inquiry capabilities in a unified, interactive setting. We extend the Countdown task to a mathematical environment where an agent probes the system by manipulating variables, collecting observations, and inferring relationships between them. This setup enables analysis of exploration strategies, causal discovery, and hypothesis refinement during inquiry. Across seven LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, our experiments reveal limited inherent inquiry capabilities and low success rates in discovering the underlying expressions. However, structured guidance inspired by educational scaffolding significantly improves performance. Our findings highlight current limitations of LLMs in strategic exploration and iterative hypothesis refinement, and show how simple guidance strategies developed for human learners in inquiry learning can support more effective inquiry behavior.
articles.bodyZh: 科学探究（Scientific inquiry）说白了就是一轮又一轮地循环（iterative cycles）：先探索，再提出假设，然后根据观察到的结果做推理，最后找出复杂系统里各种关系。大语言模型（Large language models, LLMs）在这个过程的不少环节上已经挺能打了，比如归纳推理（inductive reasoning）、提出假设（hypothesis generation）和数据分析（data analysis）。不过，以前的研究通常是把这些能力拆开单独测，所以模型到底能不能把它们串起来、走完整个探究循环，这事儿还不清楚。在这项工作里，我们搞了一个框架，用统一、可交互的方式来评估大语言模型的探究能力。我们把倒计时任务（Countdown task）扩展成一个数学环境：智能体（agent）通过操纵变量来试探系统，收集观察结果，再推断变量之间的关系。这样一来，就能分析探究过程中的探索策略、因果发现（causal discovery）和假设修正（hypothesis refinement）。我们测了七种大语言模型，试了多种提示策略（prompting strategies），结果发现：模型天生自带的探究能力比较有限，想发现背后表达式成功率也很低。不过，如果给它们一些结构化引导，灵感来自教育领域里的脚手架式引导（educational scaffolding），表现就会明显变好。我们的发现说明，现在的大语言模型在策略性探索和迭代式假设修正上还有局限，同时也表明，那些为人类学习者在探究学习中开发的简单引导策略，能帮模型表现出更有效的探究行为。

articles.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
articles.zh: Waypoint-OPD：通过门控同策略蒸馏迁移强化学习带来的策略变化
articles.summary: 如果你用RL训完大模型却发现能力迁不走，这篇的门控蒸馏思路是把RL带来的策略偏移搬进通用模型里
articles.author: Bingxi Hou, Guochao Jiang 等
articles.body: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
articles.bodyZh: 策略偏移蒸馏（Policy-shift distillation）会把教师模型在强化学习（RL）前后输出的对数概率（log probabilities）之间的差值，拿来当作学生模型自己生成轨迹（trajectories）时的监督信号。可光看终点处的策略偏移（endpoint policy shift），我们并不知道教师在训练过程中，局部的动作偏好（local action preferences）是不是一直沿同一个方向在变。同一个终点偏移，可能是前期和后期变化互相加强造成的，也可能是前后期变化部分抵消、甚至互相抵消造成的。我们就想看看：教师策略前期变化和后期变化之间的一致性，能不能用来指导学生做选择性迁移（selective transfer）。我们提出路标引导的在线策略蒸馏（Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation，Waypoint-OPD）。它从同一次强化学习训练里取一个教师中间检查点（intermediate teacher checkpoint），在学生模型访问过的前缀（student-visited prefixes）上，比较教师前期和后期在相对动作偏好（relative action preferences）上的变化。然后我们根据前后期变化在方向上的吻合程度，也就是方向一致性（directional agreement），给终点偏移做门控（gate）：如果两者方向相反，就把它压下去。跟只迁移终点偏移的做法比，我们的方法只多跑一次冻结教师模型（frozen-teacher）的评分（scoring pass）。我们拿强化学习训练过的 Qwen3-4B 当教师，用 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 当学生模型，在数学和代码推理任务上评估。在全部六个领域—学生设置（domain--student settings）里，Waypoint-OPD 在对比的这些蒸馏方法中，都拿到了最高的领域平均分（domain-average score）。用 Qwen3-8B 学生做的消融实验（ablations）显示，去掉门控或者把门控打乱，数学推理表现都会下降。这些结果说明，在学生训练时，可以用教师前期和后期策略变化之间的方向一致性，来给终点偏移加权。

articles.title: Decoding What iOS Location Services Send to Apple: An LLM Is an Unreliable Analyst but a Useful Toolmaker
articles.zh: 解码iOS定位服务向Apple发送了什么：LLM是不可靠的分析师，却是有用的工具制造者
articles.summary: 如果你想让LLM帮你做逆向分析或隐私审计，这篇的结论很关键——别信它的判断，但可以让它写脚本
articles.author: Douglas Leith
articles.body: Reverse engineering the data formats used by mobile software is skilled and slow, and using AI to assist with it is attractive. We evaluate this for the protobuf messages that an iPhone sends to Apple's location services. Working from Apple's binaries, we use two frontier models (Claude Opus 4.8, Codex GPT Sol 5.6) to reconstruct the schemas of protobufs observed in network traffic. The great majority of the schemas contain substantial errors, and these are hard to detect because the schemas are internally consistent. Direct AI use is therefore unsuitable for forensic and privacy analysis. AI can, however, write reliable analysis tools when their output can be validated. We use Claude to write a Python tool, Extractor, that reliably recovers protobuf schemas from Apple binaries. We validate it against binaries compiled from schemas with known answers, previously published schemas, and network measurements. We demonstrate the use of Extractor to decode and analyse the location services network traffic of a jailbroken iPhone 8 (iOS 16.7.11).
articles.bodyZh: 把手机软件用的那些数据格式逆向工程（reverse engineering）出来，既很考验技术又特别慢，所以拿 AI 来帮忙就很有吸引力。我们针对 iPhone 发给苹果定位服务（location services）的 protobuf 消息做了评估。基于苹果的二进制文件（binaries），我们用了两个前沿模型（frontier models）——Claude Opus 4.8 和 Codex GPT Sol 5.6——来重建网络流量（network traffic）里看到的 protobuf 模式（schemas）。结果发现，这些模式绝大多数都有不小错误，而且很难查出来，因为它们内部逻辑是自洽的。所以直接把 AI 用在这类取证和隐私分析（forensic and privacy analysis）上并不合适。不过，如果工具的输出能被验证，AI 倒是能写出可靠的分析工具。我们让 Claude 写了一个 Python 工具 Extractor，它能从苹果的二进制文件里可靠地还原出 protobuf 模式。我们用几类东西来验证它：用已知答案的模式编译出来的二进制文件、以前公开过的模式，还有网络测量数据。我们还演示了怎么用 Extractor 来解码和分析一台越狱 iPhone 8（iOS 16.7.11）上的定位服务网络流量。

articles.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
articles.zh: LoopAhead：为循环语言模型的解码提前投机
articles.summary: 如果你在关注循环/迭代式LLM架构，这篇用投机解码的思路解决它推理慢的老毛病
articles.author: Zixuan Liu, Nan Xue 等
articles.body: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause, while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. LoopAhead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.
articles.bodyZh: 循环式 Transformer（Looped Transformers）靠反复套用同一组 Transformer 层（Transformer layers）来提高参数效率（parameter efficiency）。不过，每生成一个词元（token），还是得一步步顺序计算（sequential computation），也要反复读取模型权重（model weights），所以解码延迟（decoding latency）依然很高。最近有一些流水线式自推测解码（pipelined self-speculative decoding）方法，会从前几轮循环的预测（early-loop predictions）里先草拟出词元，并在同一个批次（batch）中，让处在不同循环深度（recurrent depths）的词元异步（asynchronously）往前推进，这样能减少延迟。不过，它们没有充分挖掘前几轮循环的特征（early-loop features）来做更长的前瞻（lookahead），而且还是会花算力去验证那些猜错的推测分支（speculative branches）。我们提出了 LoopAhead，一个面向循环式 Transformer 的推测解码（speculative decoding）框架。它能让未来的词元更早被草拟出来，还让不同循环深度承担互补的角色。一个轻量级的前瞻草拟器（lookahead drafter, LAD）能用前几轮循环的状态（early-loop states）预测未来多个词元；更深轮次的反馈（deeper-loop feedback）会帮忙决定哪些草拟分支（draft branches）继续、哪些先暂停；最后再由全深度模型（full-depth model）拍板最终词元。LoopAhead 相比自回归解码（autoregressive decoding）最高能带来 7.82 倍解码加速，同时还能保持目标模型（target model）的输出分布（output distribution）不变。

articles.title: LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design
articles.zh: LOADBench：面向IC设计机器学习的大规模开源模拟电路数据集与基准
articles.summary: 如果你做AI辅助芯片设计，模拟电路一直缺公开数据，这个数据集可以省掉你几个月自己攒样本的功夫
articles.author: M. Leibl, F. Azevedo 等
articles.body: Machine learning (ML) for analog IC design is constrained by limited open data and the absence of standardized evaluation: results reported in different papers are typically obtained on bespoke, often closed, datasets and with ad-hoc metrics, leaving comparisons across methods unreliable. We address both gaps with a large opensource dataset and a suite of standardized benchmarks. The dataset contains more than 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies (1-, 2-, and 3-stage) in the SkyWater130 PDK, each shipped with structural and functional annotations, topology-specific sizing constraints (symmetry and sizing rules), an Ngspice testbench, and a multi-objective NSGA-II sizing run producing around 103 Pareto-optimal and 106 intermediate sizing-performance pairs per topology. On top of this data we define six benchmark tasks with precise protocols: inverse sizing, topology selection, sub-circuit classification, structural circuit generation, Pareto-membership prediction, and multi-objective optimization. Thus, the data presented here constitutes the most comprehensive dataset for ML development in over four decades of analog IC design automation. The dataset, ground-truth annotations, and reference implementations of the metric-defining routines are released under an open license, enabling reproducible and directly comparable evaluation across heterogeneous analog design automation methods.
articles.bodyZh: 机器学习（Machine Learning, ML）要用在模拟 IC 设计（analog IC design）上，一直受两个问题卡着：开放数据太少，而且没有统一的评估标准。不同论文报出来的结果，通常都是在自己定制的、很多时候还不公开的数据集上跑出来的，指标也是各用各的，结果就是方法之间很难靠谱地比较。我们想同时补上这两个短板：搞了一个大型开源数据集，还配了一整套标准化基准测试。这个数据集里包含 100 多种运算放大器（operational amplifier, opamp）拓扑，有单级、两级和三级，全部基于 SkyWater130 PDK（工艺设计套件）。每个拓扑都自带结构和功能标注（annotations）、针对该拓扑的尺寸约束（sizing constraints，比如对称性和尺寸规则）、一个 Ngspice 测试台（testbench），以及一次多目标 NSGA-II（非支配排序遗传算法 II）尺寸优化运行；每个拓扑会产出大约 10³ 组帕累托最优（Pareto-optimal）解和 10⁶ 组中间尺寸-性能配对（sizing-performance pairs）。在这套数据之上，我们又定义了六个基准任务，每个任务都有明确的协议：逆向尺寸设计（inverse sizing）、拓扑选择（topology selection）、子电路分类（sub-circuit classification）、结构化电路生成（structural circuit generation）、帕累托成员预测（Pareto-membership prediction）和多目标优化（multi-objective optimization）。所以，这里拿出来的数据，可以说是过去四十多年模拟 IC 设计自动化（analog IC design automation）里，面向机器学习开发最全面的一套数据集。数据集、真值标注（ground-truth annotations），以及定义指标那套例程的参考实现（reference implementations），都会以开放许可（open license）发布，这样各种异构（heterogeneous）模拟设计自动化方法之间，就能做可复现、也能直接对比的评估。

articles.title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
articles.zh: AVALON：基于人类播种拓扑记忆的零样本室内导航
articles.summary: 如果你在做具身导航，这篇的思路是别让机器从零乱撞，先用人给的拓扑记忆"播种"，再零样本泛化到新环境
articles.author: Jing Xia, Changyan Li 等
articles.body: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.
articles.bodyZh: 室内服务机器人（indoor service robots）经常要进入一些没建过图的建筑，而这些建筑的布局和任务约束，用户其实早就很熟。我们针对这种“人熟、机器人没见过”的场景，提出了 AVALON 这个拓扑导航框架（topological navigation framework）。它主要围绕三块来做：由人先打底的分层空间记忆（human-seeded layered spatial memory）、节点验证的拓扑执行（node-verified topological execution），以及任务触发、证据把关的人机记忆共同更新（task-triggered, evidence-gated human-robot memory co-updating）。机器人不用事先到现场走过，也不用针对特定场地专门训练。部署时只要一张平面图（floor plan）、一些地点线索（place clues），再做一次初始的拓扑-里程计对齐（topology-odometry alignment）就行。视觉深度点目标导航（visual depth point-goal navigation）会利用已经验证过的节点到达，来做平移重锚定（translational re-anchoring），不需要机器人自己建一张全局 SLAM 地图（global SLAM map）。人机记忆共同更新会把人和机器人各自掌握的信息合在一起，取长补短。人类操作员负责给出靠视觉看不出来的任务约束，并报告离线发生的环境改动（offline environmental modifications）；机器人则通过主动现场验证（active in-situ validation），提供物理状态证据（physical-state evidence）。人报告的环境变化要不要在执行任务时让机器人去验证，得看它跟当前任务相不相关（task relevance）。现场采集到的感知证据（field-collected perceptual evidence）会给记忆更新把关，这样就能把人指定的许可（human-specified permissions）和机器人实际观察到的可通行性（robot-observed traversability）清楚分开。我们在 Unitree Go2 上做的实验显示，AVALON 搭配 X-NavDP，不用建图，就能在 46.4 秒里完成一段 12.81 米的从交叉口到餐厅（Intersection-to-Dining）任务，5 次跑成 5 次。相比 DimOS-Go2 的 78.5 秒、5 次跑成 4 次，机器人耗时少了 40.9%；而只用策略的 X-NavDP 则 5 次全部超时。这些都说明，我们提出的这套拓扑导航框架更胜一筹。
